qkd_hr_cdc_ch.note: qm ingress (core->host) + done (host->core) W546 CDC channels + visibility-fence synchronisers

qkd_hr_cdc_hi.note: native_qm host stream (host->ingest, W514) + completion (ingest->host, W64)

qkd_hr_cdc_ci.note: native_qm HBM write face out (ingest->core) + read return (core->ingest)
